items.raw_excerpt: Film, poetry and a new collection come together at Bíó Paradís on August 21 in memory of poet and cultural journalist Ásgeir H. Ingólfsson.
items.summary_en: Bíó Paradís in Reykjavík will hold a memorial event on August 21. It honours the poet and cultural journalist Ásgeir H. Ingólfsson. The evening will have a film, poetry readings and a new book of his work.
items.summary_ko: 레이캬비크의 비오 파라디스에서 8월 21일 추모 행사가 열린다. 이 행사는 시인이자 문화 기자인 아스게이르 H. 잉골프손을 기린다. 저녁에는 영화 상영, 시 낭송, 그리고 그의 새 시집 출간이 함께 준비된다.
items.title_en: Iceland Cinema to Honour Poet Ásgeir H. Ingólfsson

items.title_original: Bíó Paradís to Honour Ásgeir H. Ingólfsson with Film, Poetry and New Book

items.raw_excerpt: El delantero argentino de 26 años llega desde AD Ceuta de España y reforzará el plantel dirigido por Lucas Bovaglio para el segundo semestre de la temporada.
items.summary_en: O'Higgins made the signing official. Argentine forward Ignacio Schor, 26, joins from AD Ceuta of Spain. He will strengthen the team led by Lucas Bovaglio for the second half of the season.
items.summary_ko: 오이긴스가 영입을 공식 발표했다. 26세 아르헨티나 공격수 이냐시오 쇼르가 스페인 AD 세우타에서 합류한다. 그는 루카스 보바글리오 감독이 이끄는 팀을 시즌 후반기에 보강할 예정이다.
items.title_en: O'Higgins make Ignacio Schor signing official until end of 2027

items.raw_excerpt: A 28-metre ship inspired by Viking vessels is set to arrive in the Algarve this weekend, as its crew prepares for a much bigger adventure across the North Atlantic.
items.summary_en: A 28-metre ship built in the style of a Viking vessel will arrive in the Algarve this weekend. The crew is preparing for a much bigger trip across the North Atlantic.

items.raw_excerpt: An Irish woman working in construction has been crowned Miss Galaxy International.
items.summary_en: An Irish woman who works in construction won the Miss Galaxy International pageant. She said she feels very proud. Her win celebrates working people in a job where women are rare.
items.summary_ko: 건설 현장에서 일하는 아일랜드 여성이 미스 갤럭시 인터내셔널 대회에서 우승했습니다. 그녀는 이번 우승이 매우 자랑스럽다고 말했습니다. 여성 근로자가 드문 직업에서 일하는 사람들에게 힘을 주는 이야기입니다.
items.title_en: Irish construction worker wins Miss Galaxy title

items.raw_excerpt: Las complicaciones generadas por las lloviznas obligaron a interrumpir las actividades escolares en seis establecimientos de la zona. Varias estructuras de alumbrado sufrieron fracturas en las inmediaciones del Aeropuerto Internacional de Iquique.
items.summary_en: A frontal system caused a massive power outage in Chile's Arica region. Light drizzle forced six schools to stop classes. Several street light structures broke near Iquique International Airport.

items.raw_excerpt: The SRC of the CPUT says stakeholders were not consulted regarding the institution's FRP
items.summary_en: The Student Representative Council at CPUT says the university did not talk to them before making its Financial Recovery Plan. Students want the plan to be more open. They held a protest about it.
items.summary_ko: CPUT 학생회는 대학이 재정 회복 계획을 만들 때 학생들과 협의하지 않았다고 밝혔다. 학생들은 계획이 더 투명해야 한다고 요구하며 항의했다.
items.title_en: Students at CPUT protest over lack of transparency

items.title_original: SRC at CPUT protest lack of transparency over Financial Recovery Plan

items.raw_excerpt: On World Elephant Day, leaders advocate for transforming human-elephant conflict into coexistence through innovative conservation initiatives.
items.summary_en: On World Elephant Day, leaders called for new ways to turn human-elephant conflict into peaceful coexistence. They shared ideas for protecting elephants while keeping local people safe.
items.summary_ko: 세계 코끼리의 날을 맞아 지도자들은 코끼리와 사람 사이의 갈등을 평화로운 공존으로 바꿔야 한다고 밝혔다. 지역 주민의 안전을 지키면서도 코끼리를 보호할 새로운 방안이 필요하다는 목소리가 나왔다.
items.title_en: Leaders urge people and elephants to live together peacefully

items.raw_excerpt: The Harvey Nichols luxury store in Dundrum Town Centre is bust and interim provisional joint liquidators have been appointed by the High Court today.
items.summary_en: A luxury store Harvey Nichols in Dundrum Town Centre has gone bust. The High Court appointed interim provisional joint liquidators today. The store is in Dublin, Ireland.

items.title_en: Harvey Nichols store in Dundrum goes bust
